# Jam App

> Free web platform for organizing in-person jam sessions and open mic nights. No spreadsheets, no group chats - just a clean interface for hosts, musicians, and audiences.

## What is Jam App?

Jam App (jamapp.com.br) is a free, browser-based tool for running live music events. A host creates a jam session on the platform, musicians browse and register for songs and instrument slots, and the audience follows the live schedule on a public dashboard - no app download required for the audience.

The platform is used for jam sessions, open mic nights, and karaoke-style music events in Brazil, with multi-language support (Portuguese, English, Spanish).

## Who It Serves

**Hosts / Organizers**: Create jam sessions with a name, date, venue, and setlist. Approve musician registrations. Control playback order in real time via the DJ control panel. Share the event via QR code or short link.

**Musicians**: Browse available jam sessions. Register for songs and pick instrument slots (vocals, guitar, bass, drums, keys). View the performance schedule and your own lineup.

**Audience / Public**: Follow the live schedule on a public dashboard - see which song is playing now, who the musicians are, and what is coming up next. No login or account needed.

## Key Features

- Create and manage jam sessions with custom schedules
- Musician registration by instrument slot (vocals, guitar, bass, drums, keys)
- Live public dashboard for venue screens - real-time updates every 5 seconds
- DJ control panel: start, pause, skip, and reorder songs during the event
- QR code and short-link sharing for quick audience access
- Spotify playlist import to build jam setlists automatically
- Multi-language: Portuguese (Brazil), English, Spanish
- Free for hosts and musicians

## How It Works (5 steps)

1. A host creates a jam session and adds songs to the setlist
2. Musicians browse available jams and register for songs they want to play
3. The host reviews and approves musician registrations
4. During the event, the host manages playback order via the DJ control panel
5. The audience watches the live public dashboard on a shared screen or their phone

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is it free?** Yes. Jam App is completely free for hosts and musicians.

**Do audience members need to create an account?** No. The public dashboard is accessible to anyone with the link or QR code - no login required.

**What instruments are supported?** Vocals, guitar, bass, drums, and keys.

**Can I import songs from Spotify?** Yes. Hosts can import a Spotify playlist to automatically add songs to the jam setlist.

**What languages does it support?** Portuguese (Brazil), English, and Spanish. The interface auto-detects the browser language.

**Is there a mobile app?** No. Jam App runs entirely in the browser on any device - desktop, tablet, or phone.

## Technical Details

- Built with React 19, TypeScript, NestJS
- Hosted on Vercel (Brazil region-compatible CDN)
- Authentication via Supabase (email/password and OAuth: Google, GitHub, Discord, Spotify)
- Real-time updates via HTTP polling (no WebSocket required)
- Available at: https://www.jamapp.com.br
